recommendation: Keep this commit as the completion of the published FHIR-25431 spelling convention. If the work group now prefers the two-word spelling, handle that as a separate editorial policy decision because it would reverse the R5-published source application.
issue_request: FHIR-25431 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction, raised in R4 and applied for R5, requesting that the datatype page and possibly related pages choose either datatype or data type and use the spelling consistently.
initial_application: The explicit Jira-tagged application commit 8592e1207273b786db340efb927bb6d1dc9756c9 on 2022-08-31 changed the datatype page title from Data Types to Datatypes and normalized many source HTML narrative pages from data type(s) to datatype(s). R5 published datatypes.html also uses Datatypes in the page title and summary.
additional_context: FHIR-I 2020-01-13 minutes contain a shorthand FHIR-25431 note saying `Using "data type" Will auto approve`, but the later applied source commit and R5 publication chose datatype(s), and no later reversal was found. Current source additions had reintroduced isolated two-word forms on active narrative pages; the remaining source/*.html two-word hits are an external Molecular Data Types IG title and generic patient-facing prose.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes.html, source/metadatatypes.html, source/dosage.html, source/fhirpatch.html, source/elementdefinition.html, source/rdf.html, source/operations.html, source/search.html, source/history.html, source/terminologies.html, and source/exchanging.html from FHIR data type(s) wording to datatype(s), preserving the substantive meaning of each passage.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: normalized two reintroduced FHIR datatype references and cleaned trailing whitespace on edited lines.
source/metadatatypes.html: normalized RelatedArtifact and Expression datatype references.
source/dosage.html: normalized DosageDetails, Timing, and Dosage datatype references.
source/operations.html: normalized operation parameter datatype wording.
source/search.html: normalized primitive/complex and search datatype wording.
source/terminologies.html: normalized terminology binding datatype wording and made the text allowance phrase grammatical.
source/exchanging.html: normalized CQL and primitive datatype wording.
